sloka: ब्रूयाः च हि महा राजम् भरतम् क्षिप्रम् आनय ।आगतः च अपि भरतः स्थाप्यो नृप मते पदे ॥२-५२-३२॥
transliteration: brūyāḥ ca hi mahā rājam bharatam kṣipram ānaya ।āgataḥ ca api bharataḥ sthāpyo nṛpa mate pade ॥2-52-32॥

translations.english: Tell the king to send for Bharata quickly, and on his arrival, he be placed in the position of the king as per his own desire.
